measures: Whether the resume evidences building systems that reason over context, call tools and take actions.
source: Criteria drafted for ticket 11 against the category 04 defined and the 6/6 evidence 02 recorded (inventory.md section 2). Structure transferred from Production ownership, as 05 predicted it would: a gate, a naming criterion, a pair of mechanism criteria, and one separator on top.

criteria.name: a system that acts
criteria.question: Does any bullet say the candidate built a system that takes actions on its own -- an agent, an agentic workflow, a tool-calling loop, a pipeline that decides its own next step?
criteria.yes_requires: A quote naming the thing built and the fact that it acts rather than answers. Calling a model in a loop and doing something with the result counts; the word 'agent' is not required.
criteria.no_looks_like: A model that only returns text -- a classifier, a summariser, a chatbot that answers and stops. Also using someone else's coding agent on your own work: that is AI-assisted coding fluency, and 02 warns this is the conflation to avoid.

criteria.name: named system
criteria.question: Is the agentic system named specifically enough to ask about in an interview?
criteria.yes_requires: A named product, service or framework in the same bullet as the system -- the triage agent, an MCP server, LangGraph, Temporal, the model it ran on.
criteria.no_looks_like: 'Built agentic AI solutions', 'delivered autonomous workflows' -- portable to any candidate.

criteria.name: what it could do
criteria.question: Does the resume say what the system could actually do -- which tools, APIs or systems it reached, or what actions it took in the world?
criteria.yes_requires: The action surface, named: the ticketing system it wrote to, the search index it queried, the refund it issued, the PR it opened, the internal APIs it was given.
criteria.no_looks_like: 'Reasons over context and takes actions' -- the job description's own words handed back with no tools in them. Two near-misses that are not an action surface: the domain noun inside the system's own name ('a ticket-triage agent' does not evidence reaching a ticketing system), and the escalation path, which is what C4 asks about.

criteria.name: what decided the next step
criteria.question: Does the resume say what drove the system from one step to the next?
criteria.yes_requires: The control, named: a planner, a router, a state machine, a retry or fallback policy, a confidence threshold, an escalation path to a human, a step budget.
criteria.no_looks_like: The system is described as a single call. Nothing says how it chose, retried, stopped, or handed over.

criteria.name: what bounded it
criteria.question: Does any bullet say what kept the system inside its limits?
criteria.yes_requires: Guardrails, authorization or scoping of what it was allowed to touch, an approval step, an audit trail, a sandbox, a rate or spend cap, or an eval that gated its behaviour. fluidstack states this as the requirement: guardrails, authorization, audit, and evals.
criteria.no_looks_like: The agent is described as capable and nothing says what it was not allowed to do.

bands.label: E
bands.name: No agentic system
bands.reads: Nothing in the resume says the candidate built a system that acts.

bands.label: D
bands.name: Claimed, not described
bands.rule: C1 met, and either C2 unmet or neither C3 nor C4 met
bands.reads: An agent is claimed, but it is unnameable, or nothing says what it could reach or how it decided anything.

bands.label: C
bands.name: Half a mechanism
bands.rule: C1 and C2 met, and exactly one of C3, C4
bands.reads: A named agent with either its tools or its control described -- not both.

bands.label: B
bands.name: Mechanism, unbounded
bands.rule: C1, C2, C3 and C4 met, C5 unmet
bands.reads: The reader can see what it reached and what drove it, and nothing says what it was not allowed to do.

bands.label: A
bands.name: Bounded agent in the world
bands.reads: A named system that reached real tools, decided its own next step, and had stated limits.

rule_share_source: 0, not 04's 0.4: ticket 07 (rule-mapping.md section 5) found this category has no deducting rule and no jd_dimensions.py dimension, so a non-zero rule_share blends the band against a constant 100 rather than a channel. Restored to 0.4 if 09 gives it a dimension.
